titleStmt.title: Memorandum of an interview between the members of the tsung-li yamén and Mr. von Brandt, January 81, 1891.

div.head: Memorandum of an interview between the members of the tsung-li yamén and Mr. von Brandt, January 81, 1891.
div.p: Mr. von Brandt had the opportunity, at the visit which the prince and ministers paid to him to-day, to speak to the prince in the sense of the aide-mémoire agreed upon, and to give his highness a copy of it at his demand. Further discussion was postponed until a conference arranged to take place at the yamén on the 31st instant. The contents of the aide-mémoire produced undoubtedly a deep impression upon the prince and ministers, who again brought forward, though in a very cursory manner, the many occupations of the Emperor, which would prevent His Majesty from receiving the ministers singly, or single ministers arriving afterwards in separate audiences.

The prince repeatedly expressed the wish that the audience might take place on the basis of the former programme, with some slight alterations, and the minister Sun-yi-wen insisted very much on the proof of great friendship on the part of China given by the willingness of the Emperor to receive the foreign ministers.
The Chinese ministers present were Prince Ching, Hsu-wen-shen, Sun-yi-wen, and Liao Shou-ming.
